items.title: Peter Bocage Interview, 1959-01-29
items.q: Mr. Trangiti liked it and he said he was gonna buy one.

ctx.x: When did you kick that up?

It's out there. Mr. Trangiti liked it and he said he was gonna buy one. That thing cost 300 something dollars. So I knew the cards on the piano, so you're not thinking just like a piano, you see. If you know a card on the piano. You can use two mallets or four like somebody? I could use three and read the cards, yeah.
So Sosa, Spanish 4 at New Orleans, 822. That must be when they took the picture.
